metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent exported document to PDF using File > Export As > Export as PDF, then confirmed save in a file dialog showing Desktop as the default save location.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate the PDF export workflow and navigate the save dialog to a different directory before confirming.
metadata.explanation: Task requires exporting to PDF with the same filename but to a different location: /home/user/Documents/ instead of Desktop. The agent must navigate to the Documents folder in the save dialog. Evaluator checks if the PDF exists there. Initial state has no PDF in Documents, so do-nothing scores 0.0.
metadata.task_rationale: Hardened variation: adds a destination-folder constraint. The agent demonstrated file-save dialog usage (step 4); this variant requires navigating from Desktop to Documents before saving.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly targets /home/user/Documents/View_Person_Organizational_Summary.pdf, covering all three instruction requirements: PDF format, correct filename, correct Documents folder location.
Metric logic (exists && size > 0) is semantically correct: a non-empty file at the expected path confirms successful export to the specified destination.
Negative control resistant: initial state has no PDF in Documents folder, so do-nothing returns 0.0.
Runtime mechanism (env.controller.get_file) is standard and reliable for file-existence checks in OSWorld.
Minor limitation: does not validate actual PDF magic bytes, so a non-PDF file placed at that path would falsely pass; however, this is a minimal risk in normal task execution context.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Optionally add a PDF magic-byte check (b'%PDF' prefix) on the returned file_bytes for stronger format validation, though this is not strictly required.
